text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having reclaimed Arthur, the party sets
out to recover the rest of Maho's plushies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アーサーを取り戻した{0}たち。
残るぬいぐるみたちを取り戻すため、行動を開始した。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
The plan is for us to split into two groups.
I assume we're all fine and dandy with that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここからは
二手に分かれてってことで、
よろしおす？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
大丈夫さ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Makes sense now that we know how to proceed,
and that'll help us deal with the sheer number of plushies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
対処法が分かった以上、
数が数だし、
分かれて動いた方が効率的だろうな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: I'll leave Makoto in your capable hands, my prince.
choice_data_list: I'll take good care of her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はん。
マコトはんのことを
よろしゅうな？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: You really are as reliable as they come, ain't ya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんま、
王子はんは頼りになるわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey now. If anything, I'll be the one protecting him.
I mean, sure, he is reliable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやいや、
どっちかってーと守ってやるのはあたしの方だろ？
そりゃ、
こいつだって
頼りになるところはあるけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-where'd that come from?!
You should save those sort of lines for Yui!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまっ、
何言っちゃってんの！？
そういうのはユイに言ってやれよ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You're as red as a tomato, Makoto. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコト、
顔真っ赤さ～♪

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's meet up later.
We'll rendezvous at the beach before sunset.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またあとで。
日が暮れる前に、
浜辺で合流な？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Don't let yourselves get distracted, okay? ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも、
道草食わないように気を付けるさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Look who's talking!
text_block_list.orig_text: そっちの方が心配だよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. C'mon, let's get going.
We're checking out the wharf, which is farther into the village.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく。
ほら、
行こうぜ。
あたしらは漁村の奥、
漁船を泊めてある桟橋の方だ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Nothing seems out of the ordinary here.
Notice anything on your end?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～、
見た感じ
特に異常はないな。
そっちはどうだ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Guess not, judging from your expression.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その様子じゃ、
こっちと同じみたいだな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh well. No sense in wandering around aimlessly,
so let's wait for a bit and see what happens.
text_block_list.orig_text:
仕方ねぇ。
闇雲に動き回っても意味ねぇし、
少し待ってみるか。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong? You can sit down, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうした、
座れよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You feeling nervous or something?
Don't worry. I'll protect you if anything pops up. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだよ緊張してんのか？
大丈夫だよ。
何が出てきても
あたしが守ってやるって♪

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's rare to see a young couple here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おやおや、
こんなところにカップルかい？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Couple?!
N-nah, you got it all wrong!
Who are you, even?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かっ！？
ちち違うっての、
いきなり誰だよ！？

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just a regular old lady.
I haven't seen you folks around before, so I came by to make
sure you're not trying to do anything funny with our boats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁに。
見知らぬ若いもんがいたからね。
漁船に悪さでもする気かと思って見に来たのさ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, makes sense.
Sorry about that, miss. I guess we are kind of suspicious.
That's not the case, though. We're with Caon—
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
そうか。
そりゃ悪かったな、
バアちゃん。
たしかに怪しいよな。
でも誤解だ。
あたしらは【自警団（カォン）】……

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine.
I'm not senile enough to interrupt a young couple on their date.
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かっとる分かっとる。
私も若いカップルの逢瀬を邪魔するほど野暮じゃないさ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I just tell you that's not the case?!
{0}! Back me up here!
choice_data_list: I have no idea who she is.
I'll take good care of her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だーかーら違うって言ってんだろ！？
{0}も誤解を解こうとしろよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
U-uh...
I wasn't expecting you to put that much distance between us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おう……
そこまで距離を離せとは言ってねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That's literally the opposite of what I asked!
You gotta... Argh! Whatever!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんで誤解を深めようとする！？
そういうのは……
あぁもういい！

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hohohoh. I jest.
Do take care, though. A Majimun was spotted around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほっほっほ。
冗談じゃよ。
だが、
気を付けなされよ。
この辺りにはマジムンが出るからの。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you heard about all that?
That Majimun is why we're here, actually.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
バアちゃんも知ってんのか。
気を付けるも何も、
あたしらはそのマジムンを探しに来たんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
I assume it's more than just a simple test of courage, by the sound of things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほお。
肝試し、
というわけでもなさそうだねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
You seem like you know your stuff,
so mind if I ask you a question?
What exactly is a Majimun, anyway?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあバアちゃん、
知ってんなら教えて欲しいんだけどよ、
マジムンってのは何なんだ？

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen one myself, alas.
All I can tell you are the legends passed down here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も見たことあるわけじゃないから、
村に伝わる話になるけどね……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
That's fine.
We need as much info as we can get right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで構わねぇ。
今は少しでも情報が欲しいんだ。

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
The term \"Majimun\" refers to evil spirits, yokai,
and all sorts of terrifying things.
It's said that they appear in all shapes and forms.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マジムンは
悪霊や妖怪、
恐ろしいもの、
怖いものを指す言葉でね。
それは色々な姿で現れると言われておる。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Just like Kaori said.
What makes them steal people's souls, then?
They must have a reason.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリの言ってた通りだな。
それで、
なんでそいつらは魂を奪うんだ？　
目的は何なんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Who knows?
All I can say for sure is that Majimun are attracted to benevolent souls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁてね。
ただ
一つ分かるのは、
マジムンが
善い魂に
惹かれるってことさ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Benevolent souls...
That might explain why the plushies were targeted in the first place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
善い魂に……
じゃあもしかして、
最初にぬいぐるみが狙われたのは……

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, don't flirt too much, okay?
Otherwise you'll attract a Majimun yourselves.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
いちゃいちゃするのもほどほどにするんだよ。
マジムンに
狙われてしまうでな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Enough with that already!
text_block_list.orig_text: それはもういいっての！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
So much for finding clues about the plushies, I guess.
She didn't see any around either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局、
ぬいぐるみ探しの手掛かりはナシだったな。
バアちゃんもぬいぐるみは見てないって言ってたし。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What's our next plan of action?
It's starting to get late, so should we meet up with the princess and Kaori?
text_block_list.orig_text:
これからどうすっかな。
そろそろ日も傾いてきたし、
一旦姫さんたちと合流するか？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's with the blank stare?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おい、
どうしたんだよ？　
キョトンとした顔して？

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Those are the princess's plushies...
Lancelot and Gawain!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
ありゃ姫さんの……
ランスロットとガウェインじゃねぇか！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wh-what is it?
Am I not allowed to remember their names or something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　な、
なんだよ。
あたしがぬいぐるみの名前覚えてちゃ悪いかよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't give me that look!
I know what you're thinking, and it's wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだその優しげな顔は！
変な誤解してんじゃねぇぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Argh, we ain't got the time for this!
Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
そんなことしてる場合じゃねぇ！
　
行くぞ！

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Lancelot. Gawain.
The princess is super worried about you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よぉ
ランスロットにガウェイン。
姫さんが心配してたぜ……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
We just gotta give them a good scare, right?
Let's do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
驚かせればいいんだよな……
行くぜ！

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Tch! They're both coming at us at once!
And they're fast, to boot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちっ、
二体同時かよ！
しかも……
速ぇ！

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Guess they don't want us getting too close!
{0}! Stick by my side!
text_block_list.orig_text:
近づけさせねぇってか！
おい{0}！
　あたしから離れるなよ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Actually, don't stick too close!
My swimsuit's kinda coming loose...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
やっぱ少し離れろ！
水着が緩んでっ……！

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Shoot! We let them close the distance!
What's going on?! It's like something's entering my body!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しまった、
近づかれて……！
なんだこれ、
あたしの中に何か入ってくる……！？

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I'm losing all my strength!
This is bad. Are they taking my soul?!
{0}, run!
text_block_list.orig_text:
力が抜ける……！
やべぇ、
これが魂を奪われるってことか……！？
{0}は、逃げろ……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
What're you...?!
Why are you coming closer? Aaaahhh?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、何を……っ！？
なんでそんな近づいて……
ひゃあああっ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Y-you're way too close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
近い、
近いって……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Quit it! This isn't right...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめろよ、
こういうのは……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Calm down! Calm down, Makoto!
He does realize I'm in my swimsuit, right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あああ、
収まれ、
収まれあたしの胸の鼓動！
っていうかあたし今水着だぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Both of us can feel all sorts of stuff like this!
What the heck's going through his head?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなに近づいたら、
いろいろ伝わっちまうじゃねぇか！
何考えてんだこいつ……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Why's he bringing his face closer?
No way... This can't be happening...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……？
　なんで顔、近づけて……？
嘘、
だよな……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Is he really gonna...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか、
本当に……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Yui!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめん、
ユイ……！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
?!
Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
！？
　へっ？

text_block_list.name: Lancelot & Gawain
text_block_list.orig_name: ランスロット・ガウェイン

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Lancelot and Gawain are back to normal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ランスロットとガウェインが、
解放された？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I feel a lot better, too...
How come?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも体が楽に……
なんでだ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, now I get it! You did that to help me, didn't you?
And I fell right for it,
which pushed the Majimun out of my body.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
なるほど！
　
つまりさっきのはあたしを助けるために？
それであたしは見事に驚かされて、
マジムンも飛び出してったと、
そういうわけだな？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense, yeah.
Come here for a sec, will ya?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
なるほどなぁ。
おまえ、
ちょっと耳貸せ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: What if my soul had popped out along with the Majimun?!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしの魂が飛び出したらどうすんだーっ！
